p: Owning architecture across desktop, services, and increasingly an agentic layer that handles routing, summarization, and anomaly review. Less framework debate, more deciding what the seams look like.
Built and maintained a WPF + service-bus stack covering line-side QC, gauge integration, and traceability. Helped retire two decades of VB6.
Plant-level applications for production reporting, weighbridge integration, and dispatch. WinForms, then WPF, then services, then services-talking-to-services.
WinForms apps for small businesses across the region. Learned how to ship to people who will call you on a Sunday if it breaks.
A first .NET 1.1 project, an old Dell, and a stack of paperback books. Twenty years later, the books are still on the shelf.
